body.heading: Where in the world is Slovenia?
paragraphs: Slovenia is a country in Southern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Slovenia is Ljubljana.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Slovenia is Slovenian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Slovenia is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Slovenia?
paragraphs: Slovenia covers about 20,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Switzerland.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Lake Bled is a fairy tale in real life — a church on a tiny island, a castle on a cliff, and cream cakes to eat after your pletna boat ride.
Ride an underground train into Postojna Cave's halls of stalactites, then see Predjama Castle built into a cliff cave mouth nearby.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Slovenia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Slovenia in one breath: a country in Southern Europe, capital Ljubljana, where people speak Slovenian and pay with the euro.
